fixture_audit: The actual two-part JSON/HMAC token and retired key lifecycle audit is rerun separately over all historical subscription fixtures and compressed branch blobs, not assumed JWTs.
scanner_projection: Verified inventory key-hash fields only are represented by their counts after independent object-name and whole-body digest validation; numeric HDR files decoded strictly from fixed headers/counts with no trailing bytes. All other decoded text scanned unmodified. Original evidence unchanged.
limitations: Entire origin/experiment/electric-replication..HEAD blob range plus every working change; not proof against arbitrary secret encodings. Fresh local S3 credentials were retired/deleted by each lab; no external/provider credentials used. Final staged closure and final commit identity must still be checked before any push.
